1.c4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Nf3 Nc6 4.d4 exd4 5..strategy: Adds a second pin to the first: the knight on f6 is tied to the queen on d8 behind it. White develops with an attack on a key defender and builds pressure on the knight on f6 before Black can untangle.

Puts the question to the bishop at once and gains a tempo: it must trade on f6, keep the pin from h4 or retreat. Black loosens nothing important on the kingside and makes White decide how to treat the pin.
